segments.narration: An electronic credit note appears as Invoice. Read the original XML. A type code of 381 identifies a credit note.
segments.caption: An electronic credit note appears as Invoice. Read the original XML. A type code of 381 identifies a credit note.

segments.narration: FACTURX and ZUGFeRD defaults also recognize 261. Codes 383 and 384 mean debit note and corrected invoice. Do not classify them as credit notes.
segments.caption: FACTURX and ZUGFeRD defaults also recognize 261. Codes 383 and 384 mean debit note and corrected invoice. Do not classify them as credit notes.

segments.narration: Open E-Doc for the detected format. A custom organization transformation takes precedence over the default. Check the active version.
segments.caption: Open E-Doc for the detected format. A custom organization transformation takes precedence over the default. Check the active version.

segments.narration: For FACTURX, search for INVOICE_TYPE. A constant Invoice can discard the original credit note code. Compare the custom transformation with the default.
segments.caption: For FACTURX, search for INVOICE_TYPE. A constant Invoice can discard the original credit note code. Compare the custom transformation with the default.

segments.narration: Test the transformed XML. Check that Extraction Paths reads invoice_type from the correct node for this format. Review later scripts and the stored value.
segments.caption: Test the transformed XML. Check that Extraction Paths reads invoice_type from the correct node for this format. Review later scripts and the stored value.

segments.narration: Create a draft. Save does not activate it. Test representative invoices and credit notes. Activate with the checkmark only after the checks pass.
segments.caption: Create a draft. Save does not activate it. Test representative invoices and credit notes. Activate with the checkmark only after the checks pass.

segments.narration: Verify a new document, including amounts and export. Preserve custom mappings. Before restarting an old document, check approvals, exports and manual edits.
segments.caption: Verify a new document, including amounts and export. Preserve custom mappings. Before restarting an old document, check approvals, exports and manual edits.

segments.narration: The negative-sign setting is enabled by default but can be disabled. Confirm classification and the sign convention expected by Infor ERP or SAP.
segments.caption: The negative-sign setting is enabled by default but can be disabled. Confirm classification and the sign convention expected by Infor ERP or SAP.
